input.body: ``` - A - B - C - D - E - F - G - H - J - K - L - M ``` ## Step to Reproduce 1. Kill the app and reopen 2. Place the caret on Thought M; 3. Tap the left side of the screen to dismiss the caret 4. Tap Thought A to move the cursor onto it 5. Tap Thought A again to place the cursor 6. Tap Export button on the toolbar 7. Tap Share button ## Current behavior Share button is showing up under the virtual keyboard. Note: if above step is not reproducible, repeat the step on other thought. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ece407f2-e27b-4bee-b287-35c8c1d98b7b ## Expected behavior Share button should not be overlapping with virtual keyboard.
input.title: [IOS Capacitor] Overlapping Share dialog and virtual keyboard when sharing while the keyboard opens
